<script type="text/javascript">
                  (function () {
                    var form = document.getElementById("emailSignupForm");
                    var formAction = form.getAttribute("action");
                    var emailInput = form.querySelector("input[type=email]");
                    var submitButton = form.querySelector("input[type=submit]");

                    submitButton.onclick = function (e) {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      submitEmailSignup();
                    };

                    emailInput.onkeypress = function (e) {
                      if (e.keyCode !== 13) {
                        return;
                      }
                      e.preventDefault();
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      submitEmailSignup();
                    };

                    function submitEmailSignup() {
                      var formFields = form.querySelectorAll("input, select, textarea");
                      var formValues = {};
                      Array.prototype.forEach.call(formFields, function (input) {
                        formValues[input.name] = input.value;
                      });

                      postToUrl(formAction, formValues)
                    }

                    function postToUrl(path, params, method) {
                      method = method || "post"; // Set method to post by default if not specified.

                      var form = document.createElement("form");
                      form.setAttribute("method", method);
                      form.setAttribute("action", path);

                      for (var key in params) {
                        if (params.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                          var hiddenField = document.createElement("input");
                          hiddenField.setAttribute("type", "hidden");
                          hiddenField.setAttribute("name", key);
                          hiddenField.setAttribute("value", params[key]);

                          form.appendChild(hiddenField);
                        }
                      }

                      document.body.appendChild(form);
                      form.submit();
                    }
                  })();
                </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
	//<![CDATA[
$(function() {
  // if hidden (inside page), remove
  $('.mologin.hidden').remove();

  $('#olb-login').click(function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    submitForm();
  });
  
  $('.input-submit').keypress(function (e) {
    if (e.which == 13) {
      e.preventDefault();
      submitForm();
    }
  });
  
  function submitForm() {
    var username = $('#UserID').val();
    var password = $('#password').val();

    var olbURL;

    if(getMobileOperatingSystem() == "unknown") {
      // desktop
      olbURL = "https://onlinebanking.fsource.org/Authentication/Username";
    } else {
      // mobile
      olbURL = "https://onlinebanking.fsource.org/Mobile/Authentication/Username";
    }

    if(username != "" & password != "") {
      var form = '<form action="' + olbURL + '" method="post" enctype="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"><input type="text" name="UserName" value="' + username + '"/><input type="password" name="Password" value="' + password  + '" /></form>';
      $(form).appendTo('body').submit();
    } else {
      if(username == "") {
        alert("Please provide your User ID.");
        $('#UserID').focus();
      } else {
        alert("Please provide your Password.");
        $('#password').focus();
      }
    } 
  }
});

/**
 * Determine the mobile operating system.
 * This function returns one of 'iOS', 'Android', 'Windows Phone', or 'unknown'.
 *
 * @returns {String}
 */
function getMobileOperatingSystem() {
  var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;

  // Windows Phone must come first because its UA also contains "Android"
  if (/windows phone/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Windows Phone";
  }

  if (/android/i.test(userAgent)) {
    return "Android";
  }

  // iOS detection from: http://stackoverflow.com/a/9039885/177710
  if (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(userAgent) && !window.MSStream) {
    return "iOS";
  }

  return "unknown";
}
//]]>
</script>
